delivery.title: Tsatanetsatane Wotumizira - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" apa imangotanthauza kuti seva yomwe mukufuna idabweza mawonekedwe a HTTP 2xx - sizikutsimikizira kuti njira yolandirira idasungidwa kapena kukonza chitsogozo. Yang'anani gulu lomwe lili pamwambapa kuti muwone zomwe linanena; ngati ilibe kanthu kapena kuvomereza chabe, dongosolo limenelo lingakhale likulandira pempho koma kukana kapena kunyalanyaza malipiro olipidwa mkati (mayina olakwika / mawonekedwe ake API , gawo lofunikira kumbali yake yomwe malipirowa sakuphatikiza, ndi zina zotero).

push.title: Webhooks Otuluka - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Zosintha mwamakonda pa webhook iliyonse : JSON , Fomu (x-www-form-urlencoded), kapena template yanu ya Custom body yokhala ndi <fieldkey></fieldkey> zosungira (monga <example></example> ) - zimagwira ntchito ngati kudzaza lamulo cURL kamodzi.
push.curlLabel: Matani cURL ya kasitomala wanu CRM
push.curlHelp: Matani chitsanzo chopempha zolemba zawo API kapena Postman amakupatsani (ndi data yeniyeni kapena zitsanzo). URL , njira ndi mitu imakopera momwe ilili, ndipo kiyi iliyonse m'thupi yalembedwa pansipa kuti mutha kusankha gawo la CRM lomwe limadzaza pa chitsogozo chilichonse.
push.curlPrompt: Muli ndi cURL ya kasitomala ? <action>Lowetsani kuchokera ku cURL</action> kuti mudzaze izi ndi mapu minda basi.
push.urlVariables: URL utha kukhalanso ndi zosintha, mwachitsanzo <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Mitu iyenera kukhala yovomerezeka ya JSON , mwachitsanzo {{example}}
push.authTitle: Kutsimikizika (momwe Leadrat amalowera mu API yawo)
push.modeSame: Tumizani chochitika chilichonse ku URL womwewo
push.modeCreateUpdate: Pangani mbiriyo kamodzi, kenako sinthani mbiri yomweyi (palibe zobwereza kumbali yawo)
push.responseIdHint: Kumene ID ili mu JSON kuyankha pempho lopanga. Kusungidwa motsogozedwa ndi <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Pakutha kwa nthawi, zolakwika za HTTP 429 ndi 5xx - pambuyo pa 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.updateBody: Sinthani thupi (lopanda kanthu = mofanana ndi kupanga)
push.howFilled: Momwe ma values ​​amakhudzidwira: webhook iyi imagwiritsidwanso ntchito pa chiwongolero chilichonse - Leadrat sichitumiza chitsanzo chokhazikika, imatumiza kukankhira kwatsopano nthawi iliyonse yomwe chochitika chosankhidwa chikuchitika, ndi zomwe mtsogoleriyo ali nazo.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Fomu imaphatikizanso gawo lililonse lotsogola - palibe chokhazikitsa.
push.howFilledCustom: Mwambo - lembani zopempha zanu ndikuyika paliponse; chilichonse chimasinthidwa ndi mtengo weniweni wa mtsogoleriyo asanatumize. Dinani chosintha pansipa kuti muyike.
push.rawTemplate: Body Template (yaiwisi) - sinthani mwachindunji kapena ikani zosintha
push.resyncTruncated_one: Resync idakankhira woyamba {{total}} cha {{count}} kutsogolera (malire {{limit}} pakuthamanga kulikonse). Chepetsani kuchuluka kwa deti kuti mukankhire zina zonse.

push.syncHelp: Kanikizaninso chitsogozo chilichonse cholembetsedwa pamasiku awa (siyani zonse zilibe kanthu kuti mukankhire chilichonse).

receive.title: Landirani - Landirani Zotsogola Mumtundu Uliwonse
receive.intro: Gwero lililonse limakhala ndi URL wake. Lozani zotsatsa zotsogola Facebook , Zapier , tsamba lawebusayiti kapena webhook lina la CRM pa izo - amatumiza otsogolera mumtundu wawo JSON kapena mawonekedwe, ndipo mumayika minda yawo kukhala yanu.
receive.urlIntro: URL wanu wolandira - perekani izi ku makina otumizira ( POST , JSON kapena fomu-encoded):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Pangani URL watsopano ? Chakalecho chimasiya kugwira ntchito nthawi yomweyo.
receive.sendExample: Tumizani chitsanzo chimodzi choyamba - chimajambulidwa ngati sampuli (palibe chomwe chimatumizidwa kunja mpaka mapu omwe ali pansipa asungidwa).

api.title: API Yanu - Njira ziwiri Zofikira pa Dongosolo Lililonse
api.intro: Dongosolo lililonse lomwe lili ndi kiyi yanu API limatha kupanga, kuwerenga ndikusintha zitsogozo ndikulembetsa kuti zitsogolere zochitika. Tumizani kiyi pamutu wa <hdr></hdr> , monga <bearer></bearer> , kapena (ngati chida sichingakhazikitse mitu) monga <query></query> . Malire: {{limit}} zopempha pamphindi.
api.noPermission: Ndi munthu yekha amene ali ndi chilolezo cha Sinthani Zochunira yemwe angawone kiyi API .
api.shownOnce: Koperani kiyiyi tsopano ndikusunga kwinakwake kotetezeka - kuti mutetezeke imawonetsedwa kamodzi kokha. Ngati chatayika, pangani china chatsopano.
api.regenerateConfirm: Kodi kupanga kiyi yatsopano API ? Kiyi yapano imasiya kugwira ntchito nthawi yomweyo pamakina aliwonse omwe akuigwiritsa ntchito.
api.openApiHint: Lowetsani zolemba za OpenAPI mu Postman , Zapier , Make kapena n8n kuti mathero aliwonse akonzekere kugwiritsa ntchito.
